title: Water stored against drought
text: Badi Lake was created under Maharana Raj Singh and named Jiyan Sagar in honour of his mother. Its purpose was practical: storing water in response to scarcity. The surrounding landscape may draw visitors today, but the lake’s history begins with the needs of the city and its communities.
